name: DCS Liberation
summary: Turn-based single-player or co-op dynamic campaign generator for DCS World.
description: DCS Liberation manages a persistent campaign and generates DCS missions turn by turn. It is a separate program distributed as a zip you extract and run.

releases.changelog: DCS 2.9.27 support (F-100D, F-14A Export), Kola and Cold War Germany maps; saves from 14.x not compatible.
